confirm.markFilledMessage_one: This moves {{count}} queued job to Filled. It doesn't fill in or submit the application; use this only if you've completed it manually.
confirm.markFilledMessage_other: This moves {{count}} queued jobs to Filled. It doesn't fill in or submit the applications; use this only if you've completed them manually.
confirm.retryMessage_one: This moves {{count}} failed job back to Queued so it's attempted again.
confirm.retryMessage_other: This moves {{count}} failed jobs back to Queued so they're attempted again.
confirm.excludeMessage_one: This removes {{count}} job from the board and permanently blacklists its URL. It will never be returned by a search or be re-queueable again, by you or the agent. You can undo this later from Job Discovery > Excluded.
confirm.excludeMessage_other: This removes {{count}} jobs from the board and permanently blacklists their URLs. They'll never be returned by a search or be re-queueable again, by you or the agent. You can undo this later from Job Discovery > Excluded.
confirm.unqueueMessage_one: This removes {{count}} job from the board, but its URL isn't blacklisted, so the agent can still find and re-queue it again later.
confirm.unqueueMessage_other: This removes {{count}} jobs from the board, but their URLs aren't blacklisted, so the agent can still find and re-queue them again later.
confirm.removeMessage_one: This permanently removes {{count}} filled or submitted job from the board. Its URL isn't blacklisted, so it can be found and queued again later.
confirm.removeMessage_other: This permanently removes {{count}} filled or submitted jobs from the board. Their URLs aren't blacklisted, so they can be found and queued again later.
confirm.markSubmittedMessage: Confirm you've actually submitted this application yourself. This action doesn't submit anything on your behalf, it just records that you did.
